important_export_consequence: For 1742/1743 visual geometry variants the shipped per-instance UV transform is invariant across every visible placement of that geometry. A glTF adapter can therefore bake the D1 UV transform once per shared geometry without destroying instancing. Only one geometry variant requires a two-way geometry split.
